raj: Heads up — planning an air-gapped private cluster bring-up for APAC-edge (customer: AcmeCorp) TOMORROW 03:00 UTC. Draft runbook below, please review for gaps. Key constraints: disconnected delivery, customer BGP peering at their colo, 4 racks (8x H100-80GB each), target initial capacity = 32 inference GPUs, reserve 32 for batch/evac.

sabrina: Ack. I'll own L3 network handshake + CIDR validation. Need the customer's L3 contact and their allowed ingress subnets.

matt: Add these quick acceptance checks to the runbook: `nvidia-smi topo -m`, `docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.2-base nvidia-smi`, and `kubectl get nodes -o wide` to confirm node labels.

carla: For the airgap bundle: we must provide a signed tarball + image tarball with sha256 sums. Who is packaging the offline registry? Also confirm whether customer wants USB or local mirror via seed server.

raj: Packaging: ops will build offline-registry: tag `redwood/offline-registry:apac-edge-2026-03-18` and produce checksums. We prefer seed-server (local NFS) where possible; fallback to encrypted USB sticks for isolated sites. Carla pls coordinate.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ticket INF-4982 created -> preflight checklist scheduled 02:30 UTC. Attachments: network precheck form, expected device inventory CSV.

raj: Runbook (condensed):
1) Pre-delivery (48h): verify rack PDU/cable plan, confirm GPU SKUs and firmware (H100 80GB, firmware v1.3.2+), get customer L3 contact, collect CIDR /42? (we need /22 for control plane + monitoring), confirm NTP sources.
2) Delivery (D0): onsite engineer unpacks, power-on check, set BMC creds to staging account, confirm BIOS settings: SR-IOV enabled, Above 4G decoding ON, iommu=pt.
3) Seed image import (D0+1): bring offline bundle to seed server. Commands we run: `ctr images import /mnt/usb/registry.tar` and `kubeadm token create --print-join-command` (but do join from staging network).
4) Drivers & CUDA (D0+1): install driver `535.104.05` + CUDA 12.2 runtime, install `nvidia-container-toolkit` and restart `containerd`. Verify `nvidia-smi` present.
5) GPU validation (D1): run health script: `./tools/gpu-health --nvlink --memtest --stress 10m` and `nvidia-smi topo -m`. Check for REMAPPED PCI addresses.
6) K8s validation (D1): ensure node labels: `redwood.workload=inference|batch`, taints applied for reserved nodes, run small perf test `python perf/latency_probe.py --model llama-2-13b --tokens 64` against local model. Confirm tail latency < 80ms per token for 1 concurrent stream on H100-80.
7) Observability (D1): confirm metrics collection (prometheus scrape via sidecar), logs shipped to local ELK, and tracing endpoint reachable from control plane.
8) Security & Secrets (D1): import customer KMS certs, validate HSM connectivity if present, rotate default creds.
9) Cutover & Handoff (D2): document capacity, commit capacity to billing, schedule canary traffic if permitted. Handoff to eng-oncall.

carla: Packaging checklist (short):
- offline-registry.tar sha256: <TO-BE-GENERATED>
- os-image.img sha256: <TO-BE-GENERATED>
- packages-list.txt (apt/rpm pinned versions)
- signed manifest + delivery envelope
If using USB, encrypt with age and seed key.

sabrina: Networking notes: Customer will advertise two /24s via BGP to our edge router. We need their ASN, peering password, and allowed next-hops. Confirmed we need static routes for monitoring VLAN (10.200.0.0/22). Also confirm firewall egress allowlist for time sync and local package manager (if allowed): `time.redwood.internal:123`, `registry.redwood.local:443` (seed).

matt: Cost/provisioning note: at list-rate equivalent this config ~ 32 H100 live + infra => estimate monthly infra cost ~ $65k/month (reserved discount pending). Add network cross-connect costs — may be $3-7k/mo depending on colo. Please add final number to the invoice sheet INF-4982.

raj: Acceptance criteria (must pass all):
- All nodes present and `Ready` in k8s; GPU count matches inventory
- `nvidia-smi` shows all GPUs healthy and correct MIG counts (if using MIG)
- Perf probe passes baseline with tails under threshold
- Prometheus metrics for GPU load, temp, power reporting
- Control-plane sync complete (if Private with control plane connectivity) or local control-plane configured and HA tested
- Signed delivery manifest uploaded to S3-seeded staging (or attached to ticket if air-gapped)

eng-oncall: I will take Handoff at 12:00 UTC D2, ensure runbook updated in CONFLUENCE -> `Infra / Private Bringups / APAC / AcmeCorp`. Set pager to critical for GPU temp > 85C and host OOM events.

carla: Quick command snippets for onsite engineer to run (place in runbook):
```
# import offline images
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/seed
sudo mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt/seed
ctr images import /mnt/seed/offline-registry.tar
# driver quick-check
modinfo nvidia | grep version
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,uuid --format=csv
# join node
<copy kubeadm join command provided by control>
```

raj: Edge constraints: APAC colo has power budget per rack 28kW, so we can't oversubscribe GPUs. Confirmed per-rack max 8x H100-80. If customer requests more, we need an extra rack and new PDUs.

matt: Also: plan for partial failure fallback — set routing policy to spill to hosted Redwood models in the region during capacity spikes (if customer allows egress). Fallback cost accounting: billed to customer as egress-overage.

carla: I'll package USBs tonight and upload manifest to ticket INF-4982. Will add sha256s once done.

sabrina: I have the customer's L3 contact: Mei Chen (mei.chen@acmecoloc.com) and ASN 64532. She will send BGP creds by EOD.

raj: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if no further changes. If you see any missing items call out now. I'll incorporate into the final runbook and push to confluence and attach to INF-4982.

ops-bot: reminder: preflight checklist runs 02:30 UTC. Report will be posted to INF-4982 when complete.
